name: Harley-Davidson Dyna (1991-2005)
engine: Evolution 80 cu in (1991-1998) or Twin Cam 88 (1999-2005) V-twin, carb or fuel injected
intro: Early Dynas came with the Evo, later ones with the Twin Cam 88. On Twin Cams, check the cam chain tensioner shoes.

add.title: Inspect the cam chain tensioner shoes
add.instructions: Pull the cam cover and look at the plastic tensioner shoes. If they are worn deep or cracked, replace them, or fit the later hydraulic tensioners or a gear drive.
add.reason: The spring-loaded shoes on 1999-2006 Twin Cams wear through and can send debris into the oil pump.
add.src: Fix My Hog Twin Cam tensioner notes

H: The tensioner step only applies to 1999-2005 Twin Cam bikes. Evo bikes use a different cam drive.
G: Most of these have a carb. Skip the fuel injection steps if yours does.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Cam chain tensioners
known.what: 1999-2006 Twin Cams (except the 2006 Dyna) use spring-loaded plastic tensioner shoes that wear out. Harley moved to hydraulic tensioners in 2006 and 2007.

forums.name: Fix My Hog
forums.what: Harley repair videos, including Twin Cam tensioner work.
